name: Beat up Gubby in His Own Home
desc:
Gubby owes the IRS money. A LOT of money. You've been sent to collect it.

Beat him up to earn money. Use the money to unlock more ways to beat him up. Slap him, throw grenades at him, drop bowling balls on him. It's all fair game. He should have paid his taxes

Don't worry though, Gubbies don't have a central nervous system so he's ok.

View the most recent updates here!
